description: This Kotlin source file defines the LocalTaskStore class, which manages task data using Android SharedPreferences for storage, providing methods for adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving tasks, with data encoding and decoding to JSON format.

classes.name: LocalTaskStore
classes.description: A class managing task data storage and retrieval, providing methods for CRUD operations and data serialization to JSON.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tasks from SharedPreferences, decoding JSON into a list of Task objects.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Encodes the list of tasks into JSON and saves it into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Serializes a list of Task objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a list of Task objects.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new task with the specified title and description, returns the new task ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID with new title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion status of a task identified by ID.
